payload.text: THE BASH TOOL'S SHELL IS ZSH, AND IT BIT FOUR WAYS ON 2026-09-23. (1) An unquoted `$list` does not word-split, so a loop over paths saw one string. My commit guard refused it, which is the only reason nothing wrong landed. (2) `${PIPESTATUS[0]}` is empty, because zsh spells it `$pipestatus[1]`. (3) A glob that matches nothing aborts the whole command (nomatch). (4) An awk run inside a double-quoted `$(...)` printed nothing over a file it should have flagged -- a page agent's measurement. Anything with arrays, word splitting or a pipeline's status runs under `bash <<'BASH' ... BASH`.
